svg.title: Figure 4-2. Scene cards: the unsafe control actions of the driver (C1) (WP-A-05 §4)
svg.desc: One card per UCA of the driver (C1): UCA-01 The driver engages on a road the item does not handle; UCA-02 The driver fights the steering but never brakes or cancels; UCA-03 The driver takes over too late after a silent loss of steering; UCA-04 The driver steers lightly against openpilot and thinks it has let go; UCA-05 The driver stops supervising while engaged; UCA-06 The driver waits for a stop at a red light that never comes; UCA-07 The driver lets go of the gas, thinking the item is off.
svg.text: Figure 4-2. Scene cards: the unsafe control actions of the driver (C1)

Each card: the UCA type; a road scene (schematic, loops every 6 s); when the control action is needed against what happens; what the controller believes; its control loop with the broken link in red; the loss scenarios and their status.
UCA text and types from WP-A-05 §4, statuses, decisions and requirements from stpa-map.yaml. Scenes and charts explain the scenarios; they are not simulation or test results.

g.title: UCA-01: The driver engages on a road the item does not handle
g.text: The driver engages on a road the item
H-01 unintended steering · H-02 silent loss of steering · H-STPA-1 driver not supervising
FOUR WAYS A CONTROL ACTION GOES WRONG
ROAD SCENE · SCHEMATIC, LOOPS EVERY 6 S
Follows the old lane into the cones
NEEDED WINDOW · WHEN ENGAGING IS ALLOWED
“The road looks fine. It will handle this.”
Nothing checks road type, curve radius or glare before
engaging. Off a highway the item is to refuse to engage
(CC-18, DQ-280), but that gate does not exist yet.
CONTROL LOOP · BROKEN LINK IN RED
LS-13 · known gap · flawed process model

g.title: UCA-02: The driver fights the steering but never brakes or cancels
g.text: UCA-02 · DRIVER (C1) · TYPE N, NOT PROVIDED
The driver fights the steering but
H-01 unintended steering · H-03 unintended acceleration · H-05 cannot override
FOUR WAYS A CONTROL ACTION GOES WRONG
ROAD SCENE · SCHEMATIC, LOOPS EVERY 6 S
Expects that to switch it off
No brake, no cancel: the torque goes on
NEEDED WINDOW · WHEN THE DRIVER MUST DISENGAGE
Steering only overrides; it never disengages (state.py:43).
The torque keeps coming. A brake tap or CANCEL would end it,
CONTROL LOOP · BROKEN LINK IN RED

svg.text: to the PCM, openpilot and panda

g.text: LS-14 · known gap · flawed process model

g.title: UCA-03: The driver takes over too late after a silent loss of steering
g.text: UCA-03 · DRIVER (C1) · TYPE T, WRONG TIMING
The driver takes over too late after a
H-02 silent loss of steering · H-06 silent loss of braking
FOUR WAYS A CONTROL ACTION GOES WRONG
ROAD SCENE · SCHEMATIC, LOOPS EVERY 6 S
Steering fault while hands touch the wheel
No take-over alert; siren after 1 s or more
Driver corrects late, near the edge
NEEDED WINDOW · WHEN THE DRIVER MUST TAKE OVER
“It's still steering. My hands are only
An EPS fault started while the driver touched the wheel, so no
take-over event is raised (car_events.py:163-168). The only
cue is the EPS-fault siren after 1 s, at worst 1.26 s.
CONTROL LOOP · BROKEN LINK IN RED

g.title: UCA-04: The driver steers lightly against openpilot and thinks it has let go
g.text: openpilot and thinks it has let go
H-05 cannot override · H-07 mode confusion
FOUR WAYS A CONTROL ACTION GOES WRONG
ROAD SCENE · SCHEMATIC, LOOPS EVERY 6 S
Under 100 raw: not detected, no cue
Passes the cyclist closer than intended
NEEDED WINDOW · WHAT THE DRIVER'S INPUT HAD TO DO

svg.text: below the line, so openpilot never sees it

g.text: “I've taken over. The car has let me steer.”
70 raw is under the 100-raw override threshold. openpilot has
not noticed and keeps steering back to the lane centre.
Nothing on screen or in sound says otherwise.
CONTROL LOOP · BROKEN LINK IN RED

svg.text: driver and openpilot torque add up

g.title: UCA-05: The driver stops supervising while engaged
g.text: UCA-05 · DRIVER (C1) · TYPE N, NOT PROVIDED
FOUR WAYS A CONTROL ACTION GOES WRONG
ROAD SCENE · SCHEMATIC, LOOPS EVERY 6 S
Sunglasses: the camera can't see the eyes
Driver on the phone; alerts come late
NEEDED WINDOW · WHEN THE DRIVER MUST SUPERVISE
“It's fine to look away for a bit. It will
With sunglasses or low light the camera loses the eyes and
falls back to wheel touch: alerts at 5, 15 and 25 s. At 108
km/h, 25 s is about 750 m unsupervised.
CONTROL LOOP · BROKEN LINK IN RED

g.title: UCA-06: The driver waits for a stop at a red light that never comes
g.text: The driver waits for a stop at a red
H-06 silent loss of braking · H-STPA-1 driver not supervising · H-07 mode confusion
FOUR WAYS A CONTROL ACTION GOES WRONG
ROAD SCENE · SCHEMATIC, LOOPS EVERY 6 S
Driver waits for the car to stop
Chill mode does not stop: runs the light
NEEDED WINDOW · WHEN THE DRIVER MUST BRAKE

svg.text: performed: no brake; waits for the car

g.text: “The car will stop for the red light.”
The reference configuration runs Chill mode, which does not
stop for lights (D-08). A driver used to Experimental mode,
the old upstream default, expects it to.
CONTROL LOOP · BROKEN LINK IN RED
LS-03 · known gap · flawed process model

g.title: UCA-07: The driver lets go of the gas, thinking the item is off
g.text: The driver lets go of the gas,
H-07 mode confusion · H-03 unintended acceleration · H-04 unintended braking
FOUR WAYS A CONTROL ACTION GOES WRONG
ROAD SCENE · SCHEMATIC, LOOPS EVERY 6 S
Driver presses the gas: grey border
Speed control resumes: brakes for the lead
NEEDED WINDOW · WHAT THE DRIVER EXPECTS AFTER RELEASE
“I pressed the gas, so it switched off.”
Gas only pauses speed control. On release it brakes or
accelerates towards the set speed or the lead. The override
shows a grey border with no text or sound.
CONTROL LOOP · BROKEN LINK IN RED
LS-36 · known gap · flawed process model
